text:
maria: Heads-up — spotted inconsistent env var names across devtools/sampleapps. Some use REDWOOD_API_KEY, others REDWOOD_KEY, and the CLI expects REDWOOD_TOKEN. New hires hit this in onboarding. Anyone know intended precedence/fallback?

ashwin: Oof. We never landed on one canonical name. Runtime fallback today: CLI flag > ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_KEY > ~/.redwood/credentials. But SDKs differ — python looks only for REDWOOD_API_KEY.

sam: That mismatch explains a few support tickets. Proposal: pick REDWOOD_API_KEY as canonical, add REDWOOD_PROJECT and REDWOOD_ORG env vars for scoping rather than embedding scope in the key. Add a --org flag to CLI for explicitness.

jules: Agree. Also think through rotation: for CI we should support short-lived session tokens via /sessions so rotation is seamless. Long-lived keys should be obvious via prefixes (e.g. rk_ for long-lived, rs_ for session).

maria: Do we have those prefixes documented anywhere? Docs currently silent.

ashwin: We added prefixes in the vault spec but never published. I'll open a docs PR. For SDKs I'll change lookup to accept all three env names but emit a single-time warning when a non-canonical var is used.

sam: Also: retry semantics. SDKs must not retry 401s. Surface an AuthFailure error with a "maybe_rotated" hint and include guidance to refresh creds. Telemetry: emit one-time event when auth fails due to rotation so we can detect mass breakage.

jules: Parity bug: JS SDK currently retries 401 once because our fetch wrapper lumps 401 with 5xx. Need to special-case 401 and bubble to app.

devops-bot: docs: https://redwood.example/docs/auth/env-conventions (automated link)

maria: I'll open a tiny RFC — canonical name REDWOOD_API_KEY, publish prefix rules, update JS/Python/Go SDKs to match fallback+warning policy. Who can triage SDK PRs? @ashwin?

ashwin: I'll take JS + docs. Ping me on the PR.

sam: I'll handle Python + add a session token helper in sampleapp (scripts/rotate-cred.sh).

jules: I'll do Go + add a cred-lint rule in repo that flags non-canonical env vars.

maria: One more ask — can sampleapp include scripts/rotate-cred.sh that demos CI-friendly rotation? Small shell: curl /sessions then writes env to .env.ci.

sam: +1, will draft and add a README snippet for CI.

maria: Thanks all :rocket:
